rca.title: An administratively disabled uplink
rca.question: Synthetic illustration shared across agents; not a benchmark question or recorded run. Client 198.51.100.10 reaches gateway Demo-Branch (198.51.100.1) but not service 203.0.113.10. Ethernet1/1 is the only uplink to Demo-Core. Identify the fault supported by the evidence.

steps.title: Inspect interface state
steps.observation:
Vlan10       198.51.100.1   up                      up
Ethernet1/1  192.0.2.1      administratively down   down
steps.summary: The local gateway is operational, while the sole uplink is administratively disabled.

steps.title: Confirm the uplink configuration
steps.observation:
interface Ethernet1/1
 description Uplink-to-Demo-Core
 no switchport
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.252
 shutdown
steps.summary: The shutdown setting explains the administrative-down state.

steps.title: Check the configured service route
steps.summary: The configured next hop is on the disabled uplink subnet. Configuration alone does not establish an installed or usable route.

rca.finalAnswer: The supported fault is shutdown on Demo-Branch Ethernet1/1, preventing forwarding to next hop 192.0.2.2 on the sole uplink. Vlan10 remaining up explains local gateway reachability. Who disabled the port and why are unknown. No repair was executed; an authorized operator would restore the intended interface state, then verify adjacency, routing, and service reachability.

path.title: Reconstruct a two-router forwarding path
path.question: Synthetic illustration shared across agents; not a benchmark question or recorded run. Reconstruct the forward path from 198.51.100.10 to 203.0.113.10. The source attaches to Demo-Edge Ethernet1/10 in VLAN 10, using gateway 198.51.100.1. Assume no ACLs, policy routing, or ECMP. Report interfaces and evidence limits.

steps.title: Resolve the first routed hop
steps.summary: The destination selects next hop 192.0.2.2 through Ethernet1/1.

steps.title: Check the first-hop adjacency
steps.command:
Demo-Edge# show ip arp 192.0.2.2
Demo-Edge# show ip interface brief
Demo-Edge# show lldp neighbors
steps.observation:
ARP: 192.0.2.2  0200.0000.0002  Ethernet1/1
Vlan10       198.51.100.1  up  up
Ethernet1/1  192.0.2.1     up  up
LLDP: local Ethernet1/1 -> Demo-Core Ethernet1/1
steps.summary: ARP and interface state support forwarding to Demo-Core; LLDP identifies its ingress port.

steps.title: Resolve the destination network
steps.command:
Demo-Core# show ip route 203.0.113.10
Demo-Core# show ip arp 203.0.113.10
steps.summary: The destination is on VLAN 20 with a resolved link-layer adjacency.

steps.title: Identify the physical destination port
steps.command:
Demo-Core# show mac address-table address 0200.0000.0010
Demo-Core# show interfaces status
Demo-Core# show ip interface brief
steps.observation:
MAC: VLAN 20  0200.0000.0010  dynamic  Ethernet1/2
Ethernet1/1  connected  routed
Ethernet1/2  connected  20
Ethernet1/1  192.0.2.2    up  up
Vlan20       203.0.113.1  up  up
steps.summary: The MAC table maps the destination to Ethernet1/2; interface state supports that egress.

path.finalAnswer: Forward path: 198.51.100.10 -> Demo-Edge Ethernet1/10 (VLAN 10, gateway Vlan10) -> Demo-Edge Ethernet1/1 -> Demo-Core Ethernet1/1 -> Demo-Core Vlan20 -> Demo-Core Ethernet1/2 -> 203.0.113.10. Routes, ARP, LLDP, interface state, and the MAC table support this snapshot-based path. They do not prove packet delivery, return-path validity, or application health. No latency or token measurements were taken.
